title: Mycelium Packaging
tagline: Growing compostable shipping foam from agricultural waste.
blurb: Open methods, open failures — every batch published as a trial.
desc: Polystyrene foam is functionally immortal and functionally unrecyclable. Mycelium grown on agricultural waste can match its cushioning performance and compost in weeks.
Every batch — including the failures — is published as a trial with method and data attached. Three labs have forked the protocol to test regional substrates; lineage keeps the results comparable.

commits.msg: Batch 3 compression results: 2.1 PSI at 40% strain
